target_interpretation: Average monthly electricity bill, not electricity use in kWh.
preprocessing: Missingness and variance-based feature screening, imputation, and one-hot categories are fit using each training fold only.
feature_engineering: The same ten rule-based features as the existing notebook; no target values are used to construct them.
model_settings: Existing HGB settings are reused. CatBoost and XGBoost use fixed, moderate tree settings; no hyperparameter search was performed.
